Provide product feedback
In the Security Copilot standalone portal, you can use the following prompt identify and
analyze scripts:
Identify the scripts in Defender incident {incident ID}. Are these malicious scripts?
Microsoft highly encourages you to provide feedback to Copilot, as it’s crucial for a
capability’s continuous improvement. You can provide feedback on the results by
selecting the feedback icon
found at the end of the script analysis card.
Learn about other Security Copilot embedded experiences
Privacy and data security in Security Copilot
 Tip
When analyzing scripts in the Security Copilot portal, Microsoft recommends
including the word Defender in your prompts to ensure that the script analysis
capability delivers the results.
